itemDisplayName: 5000 VM Scale Test - No NIC (Inline NIC Configuration)
description: Deploys 5000 individual VMs with inline NIC configuration (networkInterfaceConfigurations) to eliminate ARM NIC throttling. Each VM has 1 OS disk and 2 Premium V2 SSD data disks.
summary: Scale test deploying 5000 VMs using CRP-managed inline NIC creation to bypass ARM NIC PUT rate limits.
